1st november 2026 – feast of all saints general notices 1. the sick & housebound: will be attended on thursday and friday. 2. parish visitation: bishop martin hayes will be making a parish visitation on tuesday november 10th. mass at 8pm in laragh followed by a social in the hall. 3. petitions for assisi: fr. martin is going on pilgrimage to assisi on november 24th. if you wish to send a petition with him, please drop it into the parochial house before then. 4. preparing for advent: a practical workshop will take place on 7th november from 10.30am – 12.30pm in the pastoral centre, cavan. no registration needed. 5. children’s remembrance service: on sunday november 8th at 2pm in the community centre, ballinagh. a time to remember, honour and celebrate the children and babies who are forever loved. everyone welcome. 6. an evening of song: by the choirs of cavan rugby club, cavan singers, cavan community voices, cuan crooners and loreto college, to remember the victims of the orphanage fire of 1943 will take place on friday 6th november at 8pm in the kilmore. 7. laragh united gaa lotto results: no jackpot winner. numbers 6, 9, 30, 32 . €30 winners were geraldine fitzsimons, linda duff, tj byrd, debbie brady, terry reilly. next week’s jackpot € 10,400. 8. laragh healthy club: 6 week mobility and stability class for everyday movement, 30 minutes class and 30 minutes walking at your own pace. suitable for those over 40, commencing on tuesday 3rd november at 2pm at laragh community pitch. 9. 25 card game: has resumed in lavey community centre, on tuesday nights for the winter months starting at 8pm. everyone welcome. 10. stradone community centre/ladg: monthly meeting on tuesday 3rd november at 8.30pm in the centre. 11. breifne boxing club: is open to new members. training for 8 – 13 years on mon and wed from 6pm – 7pm. youth and seniors on mon, wed and fri from 7pm – 8.30pm. location: jacksons yard, stradone. call stephen for information
